description: Calculate and explain how RillCoin's concentration decay affects a given balance. Shows decay amount, effective value, and educational context about the sigmoid decay mechanism.

blocks_held.description: Number of blocks the UTXO has been held

concentration_pct.description: Optional: concentration as percentage of supply (e.g. 0.5 for 0.5%). If omitted, calculated from balance vs 21M max supply.
